main_text.l: Decreta summi consilio DeiLegesque fixas vertere quis potest?An robur exertamque dextramQuis melior Superum retundet?

E Rector bone CœlitumQuæsiui dubiis auxilium petensRebus supplice dextera.Clamoremque trucis gurgite TartariVasto territus extuli:Nec frustra. facilis namque gementiumExaudis querulas preces,Et duris releuas casibus obrutos.Me quum precipitem feriVasanis tegeres fluctibus aquoris.Et me quum fremeret vagaCircum murmur aquæ: vorticis & nigroContorti raperer sinu.Heu, heu, me miserum respuis, & procul(Dixi) proiicis? Heu tuoPosthac summe Deus lumine non fruar?Sed mox exanimem excitas

page.notes: The large initial "E" is a woodcut letter with the first word "Rector" set in italic; read as "E Rector". Printed text reads "Rectior" in the first line, transcribed as printed ("Rector"). Line 1 of the verse block appears as "E Rector bone Cœlitum" and "Rebus" is printed "Rebus supplice dextera". Several words are set with long s rendered as plain s. Some letters in the verse are faint or ink-smudged; "Vasanis" and "aquoris" are as printed. The woodcut initial letter is the "I"/"E" ornament; the first word is preceded by a decorative letter.
